versions.statuteQuote: Unless necessitated by the tenant's violation of a requirement of this chapter, no landlord shall require a tenant to pay any fee for the maintenance or repair of any dwelling unit.

summaryForModel: A landlord may not charge the tenant a fee for maintenance or repair of the unit unless the tenant's own violation of the VRLTA (for example, damage the tenant caused) made it necessary. A lease that adds a maintenance fee, a repair request fee, or a flat repair charge conflicts with this.
paraphraseExamples: Tenant shall pay a $50 service charge for each maintenance request.
A monthly maintenance fee of $25 will be added to rent.
tenantExplanation: Your landlord can't charge you a fee for repairs or maintenance unless you caused the problem.
action: You can ask your landlord to remove this fee before you sign.
